articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: In this case-control study across 52 countries, nine modifiable risk factors together accounted for 90% of the population-attributable risk of a heart attack in men and 94% in women, with smoking and abnormal lipids contributing most.
articles.titleZh: 九项可改变因素解释了全球约九成心梗风险
articles.titleEn: Nine modifiable risk factors explain about nine in ten heart attacks worldwide
articles.summaryZh: 麦克马斯特大学牵头的国际病例对照研究，15152 例心梗患者与 14820 名对照。
articles.summaryEn: An international case-control study led by the Population Health Research Institute at McMaster University, with 15,152 heart attack patients and 14,820 controls.
articles.bodyZh:
研究在 52 国纳入 15152 例首次心梗患者与 14820 名匹配对照，测量吸烟、血压、糖尿病、腰臀比、饮食、运动、饮酒、血脂和心理社会因素共 9 项。

吸烟（PAR 35.7%）、血脂异常（PAR 49.2%）、高血压、糖尿病、腹型肥胖（PAR 20.1%）与心理社会因素（PAR 32.5%）是危险因素；每天吃蔬果（0.70）、规律运动（0.86）是保护因素。九项合计解释男性 90%、女性 94% 的 PAR。

病例对照研究只能说明相关：发病后回忆的饮食与压力可能与病前不同（回忆偏倚）。人群归因风险（PAR）是群体估计，不等于“消除这些因素个人风险降九成”。研究把规律饮酒列为保护因素（OR 0.91），后被更大分析修正。

实操建议：不必一次改九项，挑最超标的一项（吸烟、血压或血脂）做三个月。
articles.bodyEn:
Using one standardized protocol in 52 countries, the study enrolled 15,152 people with a first acute heart attack and 14,820 controls matched for age, sex and location. It measured nine factors: smoking, history of hypertension and diabetes, waist-to-hip ratio, diet, exercise, alcohol, apolipoproteins and psychosocial factors.

Smoking (OR 2.87, PAR 35.7%), a raised ApoB/ApoA1 ratio (OR 3.25, PAR 49.2%), hypertension (OR 1.91), diabetes (2.37), abdominal obesity (PAR 20.1%) and psychosocial factors (OR 2.67, PAR 32.5%) were all risk factors. Daily fruit and vegetables (0.70) and regular exercise (0.86) were protective. Together the nine explained 90% of PAR in men and 94% in women.

A case-control study can only show association: people who have just had a heart attack may recall their diet and stress differently (recall bias). Population-attributable risk is a group-level estimate; it does not mean removing these factors cuts your own risk by 90%. The study counted regular drinking as protective (OR 0.91), a conclusion later revised by larger analyses.

Practical tip: You do not have to change nine things at once. Pick the one factor most clearly out of range for you, usually smoking, blood pressure or blood lipids, work on it for three months, then move to the next.
articles.citation: Yusuf S, Hawken S, Ounpuu S, et al.; INTERHEART Study Investigators. Effect of potentially modifiable risk factors associated with myocardial infarction in 52 countries (the INTERHEART study): case-control study. Lancet. 2004;364(9438):937-952.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：汇总 26 项随机试验、约 17 万人后发现，LDL 胆固醇每降低 1 mmol/L，主要血管事件减少约 22%（RR 0.78），全因死亡减少 10%。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: Across 26 randomized trials with about 170,000 participants, each 1 mmol/L reduction in LDL cholesterol lowered major vascular events by about 22% (rate ratio 0.78) and deaths from any cause by 10%.
articles.titleZh: LDL每降1 mmol/L，主要血管事件减少约两成
articles.titleEn: Each 1 mmol/L drop in LDL cholesterol cut major vascular events by about a fifth
articles.summaryZh: 牛津大学协调的个体数据荟萃分析，26 项他汀随机试验、约 17 万人。
articles.summaryEn: An individual-participant data meta-analysis coordinated by the Clinical Trial Service Unit at Oxford, pooling 26 randomized statin trials with about 170,000 people.
articles.bodyZh:
CTT 协作组汇总 26 项他汀随机试验的个体数据：5 项比较“更强 vs 较弱”方案（39612 人），21 项比较“他汀 vs 对照”（129526 人），统一计算每降低 1.0 mmol/L LDL 胆固醇对应的风险变化。

LDL 每降低 1.0 mmol/L，主要血管事件（心梗、血运重建、缺血性卒中）率比 0.78，即降约 22%；全因死亡 RR 0.90，降 10%。在所研究范围内未见明显阈值，即使基线已低于 2 mmol/L 仍呈相近比例下降。

汇总的是随机试验，因果性较强，但受试者多为已患病或高危人群，套用到低风险者需谨慎。数据来自他汀试验，不能推断“吃某种食物同样有效”，也不能据此自行用药。

实操建议：血脂报告别只看箭头，记下这次的 LDL 数值和日期，与上一次对比看变化方向。
articles.bodyEn:
The Cholesterol Treatment Trialists' Collaboration pooled individual data from 26 randomized statin trials: five comparing more versus less intensive regimens (39,612 people) and 21 comparing statins with control (129,526 people). For both types they calculated the risk change per 1.0 mmol/L reduction in LDL cholesterol.

Each 1.0 mmol/L lower LDL gave a rate ratio for major vascular events (heart attack, revascularization, ischemic stroke) of 0.78, a fall of about 22%. Deaths from any cause had an RR of 0.90, a 10% reduction. No clear threshold appeared within the range studied; even people starting below 2 mmol/L showed a similar proportional fall.

Because these are randomized trials, the causal link is strong. But participants mostly had existing cardiovascular disease or high risk, so applying it to low-risk people needs caution. The data come from statin trials; they do not mean a food does the same, and they are not a basis for self-medicating.

Practical tip: Do not read only the arrows on your lipid report. Write down this visit's LDL value and the date, and compare it with the last one to see which way it is moving.
articles.citation: Cholesterol Treatment Trialists' (CTT) Collaboration, Baigent C, Blackwell L, Emberson J, et al. Efficacy and safety of more intensive lowering of LDL cholesterol: a meta-analysis of data from 170,000 participants in 26 randomised trials. Lancet. 2010;376(9753):1670-1681.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：11.6 万欧洲成年人中，健康生活方式评分（满分 8 分）每高 1 分，40-75 岁间无慢性病生活的年数约多 1 年；最高分与最低分相差约 9 年。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: Among 116,043 European adults, each 1-point gain in an 8-point healthy lifestyle score was linked to about one more year lived without major chronic disease between ages 40 and 75; best versus worst differed by about 9 years.
articles.titleZh: 健康生活方式每多一分，无病寿命约多一年
articles.titleEn: One more point on a healthy lifestyle score meant about one more disease-free year
articles.summaryZh: 赫尔辛基大学等 12 个欧洲队列，116043 名基线无慢性病者，平均随访 12.5 年。
articles.summaryEn: A multicohort study from the IPD-Work consortium of 12 European cohorts, with 116,043 people free of major chronic disease at baseline and a mean follow-up of 12.5 years.
articles.bodyZh:
研究汇总 12 个欧洲队列、116043 名基线无重大慢性病者。对吸烟、BMI、体力活动和饮酒各评 0-2 分，汇总为 0-8 分，估算 40-75 岁间的“无病年数”。

平均随访 12.5 年，17383 人至少新发一种慢性病。评分每高 1 分，男性多 0.96 年、女性多 0.89 年无病寿命；最高分组与最低分组相差 9.9 年（男性）、9.4 年（女性）。无病年数最多的组合都含 BMI 低于 25。

这是观察性研究，相关不等于因果：健康生活方式常与更高的社会经济地位与医疗可及性相伴，残余混杂仍可能存在。评分中的“适量饮酒”一项后来被更大样本分析修正，不应据此认为需要喝酒。

实操建议：先算 BMI——体重（公斤）除以身高（米）的平方，看是否在 18.5-25 之间，和腰围一起记入体检档案。
articles.bodyEn:
The study pooled 12 European cohorts with 116,043 adults free of diabetes, coronary heart disease, stroke, cancer, asthma and COPD at baseline; mean age was 43.7 years. Smoking, BMI, physical activity and alcohol were each scored 0 to 2, giving a total score of 0 to 8, and disease-free years between ages 40 and 75 were estimated.

Over a mean follow-up of 12.5 years, 17,383 people developed at least one chronic disease. Each 1-point higher score went with 0.96 more disease-free years in men and 0.89 in women. The best and worst scores differed by 9.9 disease-free years in men and 9.4 in women. The most favorable profiles all included a BMI under 25.

This is observational, so association is not causation. Healthy habits travel with higher socioeconomic status and better access to care, and residual confounding remains. The “moderate drinking” component has since been revised by larger analyses, so this is not a reason to start drinking.

Practical tip: Start with the most measurable item. Divide your weight in kilograms by your height in meters squared to get your BMI, see whether it falls between 18.5 and 25, and record it with your waist measurement in your check-up file.
articles.citation: Nyberg ST, Singh-Manoux A, Pentti J, et al. Association of Healthy Lifestyle With Years Lived Without Major Chronic Diseases: A Multicohort Study. JAMA Intern Med. 2020;180(5):760-768.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：汇总70项研究、340万人后发现，社会隔离、孤独感和独居分别对应死亡几率上升29%、26%和32%（比值比1.29、1.26、1.32）。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: Across 70 studies with 3.4 million people, social isolation, loneliness, and living alone were linked to 29%, 26%, and 32% higher odds of death (odds ratios 1.29, 1.26, and 1.32).
articles.titleZh: 孤独与社会隔离和早逝风险上升相关
articles.titleEn: Loneliness and social isolation are linked to higher mortality risk
articles.summaryZh: 70项研究、超过340万人的荟萃分析，由美国杨百翰大学研究者完成，平均随访7.1年。
articles.summaryEn: A meta-analysis of 70 studies covering 3,407,134 participants with an average 7.1-year follow-up, by researchers at Brigham Young University.
articles.bodyZh:
研究者检索了1980年1月至2014年2月间发表、提供死亡率数据的研究，纳入70项独立研究，共3,407,134名参与者，平均随访7.1年，分别考察社会隔离、孤独感与独居三项。

控制多种混杂因素后，三者的合并比值比分别为：社会隔离1.29、孤独感1.26、独居1.32，相当于死亡几率上升29%、26%和32%。结果在性别、随访时长和世界各区域间一致，且在平均年龄小于65岁的样本中更明显。

纳入的都是观察性研究，相关不等于因果：也可能是健康先恶化、社交才减少。多数研究只测量了三个维度中的一个，独居也只是粗略的替代指标。效应量在充分调整后变小，但仍具统计学意义。

实操建议：维持几段能说真话的紧密关系，比扩大社交人数更关键；如果感到孤独，从每周一次固定联系开始，而不是等到有事才联系。
articles.bodyEn:
The authors searched for studies published between January 1980 and February 2014 that reported mortality data. They included 70 independent studies with 3,407,134 participants and an average follow-up of 7.1 years, covering objective social isolation, subjective loneliness, and living alone.

After statistically controlling for many confounders, the pooled odds ratios were 1.29 for social isolation, 1.26 for loneliness, and 1.32 for living alone, equal to 29%, 26%, and 32% higher odds of death. Results held across sex, follow-up length, and world region, and were stronger in samples with an average age under 65.

All included studies were observational, so association is not causation: poor health may come first and shrink social life later. Most studies measured only one of the three dimensions, and living alone is a rough proxy. Effect sizes shrank after full adjustment but remained statistically significant.

Practical tip: A few relationships where you can be honest matter more than a long contact list. If you feel lonely, start with one fixed weekly call rather than reaching out only when you need something.
articles.citation: Holt-Lunstad J, Smith TB, Baker M, Harris T, Stephenson D. Loneliness and social isolation as risk factors for mortality: a meta-analytic review. Perspect Psychol Sci. 2015;10(2):227-237.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：47项随机对照试验、3,515人的荟萃分析显示，正念冥想对焦虑（效应量0.38）、抑郁（0.30）和疼痛（0.33）有小到中等程度的改善。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: In a meta-analysis of 47 randomized trials with 3,515 participants, mindfulness meditation produced small to moderate improvements in anxiety (effect size 0.38), depression (0.30), and pain (0.33).
articles.titleZh: 正念冥想对焦虑抑郁有小到中等的改善
articles.titleEn: Mindfulness meditation brings small to moderate gains in anxiety and depression
articles.summaryZh: 47项主动对照的随机对照试验荟萃分析，共3,515名成年人，由约翰霍普金斯大学循证实践中心完成。
articles.summaryEn: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 47 randomized trials with active controls (3,515 adult participants) from the Johns Hopkins Evidence-based Practice Center.
articles.bodyZh:
约翰霍普金斯团队筛检18,753条文献，纳入47项设有主动对照（可排除安慰效应）的随机对照试验，共3,515名成年人，评估正念冥想对焦虑、抑郁、压力、睡眠与疼痛的影响。

8周时，正念冥想对焦虑的合并效应量为0.38（95%CI 0.12-0.64），对抑郁为0.30（0.00-0.59），对疼痛为0.33（0.03-0.62），均属小到中等改善；3至6个月后效应变小但仍存在。对压力与生活质量的证据较弱。

不少试验样本小、偏倚风险高，部分结果可能存在发表偏倚；对积极情绪、注意力、睡眠和体重几乎没有效果证据。研究也没发现冥想优于药物、运动或其他行为疗法，它更像可选项而非替代方案。

实操建议：想试的话，从每天10分钟、连续8周的练习开始，用App或课程跟练，比想起来才做一次更容易看到变化。
articles.bodyEn:
A Johns Hopkins team screened 18,753 citations and included 47 randomized trials with active controls, which helps separate real effects from placebo. Together they covered 3,515 adults and measured anxiety, depression, stress, quality of life, sleep, pain, and more.

At 8 weeks, mindfulness meditation programs produced pooled effect sizes of 0.38 for anxiety (95% CI, 0.12-0.64), 0.30 for depression (0.00-0.59), and 0.33 for pain (0.03-0.62), all small to moderate. The effects were smaller but still present at 3 to 6 months. Evidence for stress and mental health-related quality of life was weaker.

Many trials were small with a high risk of bias, and some outcomes may be affected by publication bias. There was little or no evidence of benefit for positive mood, attention, sleep, or weight. Meditation was not shown to be better than drugs, exercise, or other behavioural therapies, so it is an option, not a replacement.

Practical tip: If you want to try it, commit to 10 minutes a day for 8 weeks, ideally with an app or a course. A steady routine works better than meditating only when you happen to remember.
articles.citation: Goyal M, Singh S, Sibinga EMS, et al. Meditation programs for psychological stress and well-being: a systematic review and meta-analysis. JAMA Intern Med. 2014;174(3):357-368.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：53454 名重度吸烟者的随机试验显示，每年一次低剂量胸部 CT 让肺癌死亡率比胸片相对下降 20.0%，全因死亡下降 6.7%，但假阳性很多。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: In a randomized trial of 53,454 heavy smokers, annual low-dose chest CT lowered lung cancer mortality by 20.0% relative to chest X-ray and deaths from any cause by 6.7%, with many false positives.
articles.titleZh: 低剂量CT筛查让重度吸烟者肺癌死亡降两成
articles.titleEn: Low-dose CT screening cut lung cancer deaths by 20% in heavy smokers
articles.summaryZh: 美国国家癌症研究所资助的随机对照试验，33 家中心、53454 名重度吸烟者。
articles.summaryEn: A randomized controlled trial funded by the US National Cancer Institute at 33 centers, with 53,454 heavy smokers.
articles.bodyZh:
2002-2004 年，研究纳入 53454 名 55-74 岁、吸烟至少 30 包年者（已戒烟者须戒烟未满 15 年），随机接受每年一次低剂量螺旋 CT（26722 人）或胸部 X 线（26732 人）共三年，依从率超过 90%。

肺癌死亡率 CT 组每 10 万人年 247 例、胸片组 309 例，相对下降 20.0%；全因死亡下降 6.7%。代价是假阳性多：三轮筛查中 CT 阳性结果有 96.4% 最终不是肺癌，可能带来更多影像或有创检查。

随机试验意味着死亡率下降可归因于筛查，但结论只适用于入组的这类高危人群，不能直接推广到年轻或轻度吸烟者。筛查也不等同于戒烟。

实操建议：先核对本地筛查项目的年龄与吸烟量门槛（常见为 50-75 岁、20 包年以上）；无论筛不筛查，戒烟的收益都更大。
articles.bodyEn:
Between 2002 and 2004 the trial enrolled 53,454 people aged 55 to 74 with at least 30 pack-years of smoking, including former smokers who had quit within 15 years. They were randomized to three annual rounds of low-dose spiral CT (26,722 people) or chest X-ray (26,732 people), then followed further. Adherence was over 90%.

Lung cancer mortality was 247 per 100,000 person-years in the CT group and 309 in the X-ray group, a relative reduction of 20.0%. Deaths from any cause fell by 6.7%. The cost is false positives: across the three rounds, 96.4% of positive CT results turned out not to be lung cancer, which can lead to more imaging or invasive tests.

Because it was a randomized trial, the drop in lung cancer deaths can be attributed to screening. But the result applies only to this kind of high-risk group and does not extend to younger or lighter smokers. Screening is not a substitute for quitting.

Practical tip: Check the age and smoking thresholds of your local screening program, often 50-75 years and 20 or more pack-years. Either way, quitting gives more benefit than screening does.
articles.citation: National Lung Screening Trial Research Team; Aberle DR, Adams AM, Berg CD, et al. Reduced Lung-Cancer Mortality with Low-Dose Computed Tomographic Screening. N Engl J Med. 2011;365(5):395-409.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：柳叶刀污染与健康委员会估计，污染每年与约 900 万例过早死亡相关，占全球死亡总数的 16%，其中 92% 发生在中低收入国家。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: The Lancet Commission on pollution and health estimated that pollution is linked to about 9 million premature deaths a year, 16% of all deaths worldwide, with 92% of them in low- and middle-income countries.
articles.titleZh: 污染每年与约900万例过早死亡相关
articles.titleEn: Pollution is linked to about 9 million premature deaths each year
articles.summaryZh: 柳叶刀委员会的全球评估报告，汇总空气、水、土壤与化学污染的疾病负担。
articles.summaryEn: A global assessment from The Lancet Commission, summarizing the disease burden of air, water, soil and chemical pollution.
articles.bodyZh:
报告由波士顿学院、伦敦国王学院等机构专家完成，汇总室外与室内空气污染、水污染、土壤污染、化学物和职业暴露的健康影响，并估算经济代价，与艾滋病、结核病、疟疾等作量级对比。

核心数字：污染每年与约 900 万例过早死亡相关，占全球死亡 16%，约为艾滋病、结核病与疟疾合计的 3 倍；92% 发生在中低收入国家。相关疾病使发展中国家 GDP 每年损失最高 2%，婴幼儿尤其脆弱。

这 900 万是模型推算的归因死亡估计，不是逐一确认的个案；各类污染的证据强度不一，新型化学物仍缺数据。报告讲的是人群层面风险，无法据此算出个人风险。

实操建议：关注本地空气质量指数，高污染时段减少户外剧烈运动；室内烹饪开抽油烟机，尽量不用固体燃料。
articles.bodyEn:
Experts from institutions including Boston College and King's College London compiled the health effects of outdoor and household air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, chemical pollution and occupational exposure, estimated their economic costs, and compared the scale with AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria.

The headline numbers: pollution is linked to about 9 million premature deaths a year, 16% of all deaths worldwide and roughly three times the combined toll of AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria. Ninety-two percent occur in low- and middle-income countries. Pollution-related disease cuts developing-country GDP by up to 2% a year, and infants and young children are especially vulnerable.

These 9 million deaths are estimated from epidemiological models, not individually confirmed cases. The strength of evidence differs by pollution type, and data on newer chemicals remain sparse. The report describes population-level risk, not any one person's risk.

Practical tip: Check your local air quality index and avoid hard outdoor exercise during heavy pollution. Use an extractor hood when cooking indoors and avoid burning solid fuels.
articles.citation: Landrigan PJ, Fuller R, Acosta NJR, et al. The Lancet Commission on pollution and health. Lancet. 2018;391(10119):462-512.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：在这项 9361 人的随机试验中，把收缩压目标定在 120 mmHg 以下（而非常用的 140 以下），心血管事件减少 25%，全因死亡减少 27%。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: In a randomized trial of 9,361 high-risk adults, targeting systolic blood pressure below 120 mm Hg instead of below 140 cut cardiovascular events by 25% and deaths from any cause by 27%.
articles.titleZh: 降压目标降到120以下，心血管事件减少四分之一
articles.titleEn: A lower blood-pressure target cut cardiovascular events by 25%
articles.summaryZh: 美国国立卫生研究院资助的随机对照试验，9361 名 50 岁以上血压偏高且有心血管危险因素者。
articles.summaryEn: A randomized controlled trial funded by the US National Institutes of Health, in 9,361 people aged 50 or older with high blood pressure and cardiovascular risk factors.
articles.bodyZh:
试验在美国约 100 个中心纳入 9361 名 50 岁以上、收缩压 130-180 mmHg 且至少有一个心血管危险因素者（排除糖尿病与既往卒中），随机分到收缩压 <120 或 <140 mmHg 两组，靠调整药物达标。

一年后强化组平均收缩压 121.4 mmHg，标准组 136.2 mmHg。强化组主要终点（心梗、卒中、心衰或心血管死亡）下降 25%，全因死亡下降 27%，心衰下降 38%；代价是低血压、晕厥和急性肾损伤更多，平均多用药一种。

随机试验的因果结论较强，但强化组不良事件确实更多，受试者又是筛选出的高危人群，不能直接外推到所有人。目标是否定在 120 以下需由医生结合个人情况判断。

实操建议：先把血压测准——连续一周固定时间、静坐 5 分钟后测量并记录，带着记录复诊。
articles.bodyEn:
The trial enrolled 9,361 people aged 50 or older at about 100 US centers. All had systolic blood pressure of 130-180 mm Hg and at least one cardiovascular risk factor. People with diabetes or a previous stroke were excluded. Participants were randomized to a target below 120 mm Hg or below 140 mm Hg, reached by adjusting medication.

After one year the intensive group averaged 121.4 mm Hg and the standard group 136.2 mm Hg. The intensive group had 25% fewer primary events (heart attack, stroke, heart failure or cardiovascular death), a 27% lower risk of death from any cause, and 38% less heart failure. The cost: more low blood pressure, fainting and acute kidney injury, and roughly one extra drug.

Because this was a randomized trial, the causal conclusion is fairly strong. But the intensive group did have more side effects, and participants were selected high-risk patients, so the result cannot be extended to everyone. Whether a target below 120 suits you is a decision for you and your doctor.

Practical tip: Measure your blood pressure properly first. Take it at the same time each day for one week after sitting quietly for five minutes, write the numbers down, and bring the record to your appointment.
articles.citation: SPRINT Research Group. A Randomized Trial of Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control. N Engl J Med. 2015;373(22):2103-2116.

articles.conclusionZh: 结论：汇总 72 项队列、252 万人后发现，腰围每增加 10 厘米，全因死亡风险上升约 11%（HR 1.11），且这一关联在调整 BMI 后依然存在。
articles.conclusionEn: Bottom line: Pooling 72 cohorts with 2.5 million people, each 10 cm increase in waist circumference was linked to an 11% higher risk of death from any cause (HR 1.11), even after adjusting for BMI.
articles.titleZh: 腰围每粗10厘米，全因死亡风险上升约11%
articles.titleEn: Every 10 cm of extra waist circumference was linked to 11% higher mortality
articles.summaryZh: 德黑兰医科大学与多伦多大学团队的荟萃分析，72 项前瞻队列共 252 万人。
articles.summaryEn: A dose-response meta-analysis by researchers at Tehran University of Medical Sciences and the University of Toronto, covering 72 prospective cohorts with 2.5 million people.
articles.bodyZh:
研究者检索至 2019 年 7 月的文献，纳入 72 项报告至少三种中心性肥胖指标分层的前瞻队列研究，共 2528297 人，比较腰围、臀围、大腿围、腰臀比、腰高比和体型指数等。

多数中心性肥胖指标与全因死亡正相关，且调整 BMI 后依然成立：腰围每增 10 厘米 HR=1.11，腰臀比每增 0.1 HR=1.20，腰高比每增 0.1 HR=1.24；相反臀围每增 10 厘米 HR=0.90。脂肪长在哪里比总量更关键。

这是观察性研究的汇总，不能证明“减腰围就能延寿”——未测量的生活习惯或潜在疾病可能同时影响两者。研究间异质性较高（I² 多在 75% 以上），腰围测量位置也不统一。

实操建议：站直、呼气末在肚脐水平绕一圈量腰围，固定清晨空腹、同一位置测量并记下来，每 3 个月看趋势。
articles.bodyEn:
The researchers searched the literature up to July 2019 and included 72 prospective cohort studies reporting risk across at least three categories of central fatness, with 2,528,297 participants. They compared waist, hip and thigh circumference, waist-to-hip ratio, waist-to-height ratio and A body shape index.

Most measures of central fatness were positively linked to death from any cause, and this held after adjusting for BMI: each 10 cm of waist gave an HR of 1.11, each 0.1 unit of waist-to-hip ratio 1.20, and each 0.1 unit of waist-to-height ratio 1.24. In the other direction, each 10 cm of hip gave 0.90. Where fat sits matters more than how much there is.

This is a synthesis of observational studies, so it cannot prove that shrinking your waist lengthens your life. Unmeasured habits or underlying illness could drive both. Heterogeneity was high (I² above 75% in most analyses) and waist measuring sites were not standardized.

Practical tip: Stand straight, breathe out, and wrap the tape at navel level. Measure in the morning before eating, at the same spot each time, write it down, and check the trend every three months.
articles.citation: Jayedi A, Soltani S, Zargar MS, Khan TA, Shab-Bidar S. Central fatness and risk of all cause mortality: systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of 72 prospective cohort studies. BMJ. 2020;370:m3324.
